text:
maya: Quick sync — experiment plan for SLO-driven edge routing + circuit-breaker tuning. TL;DR: prefer low-latency region for Gold, failover to quantized model-variant when p95 > 180ms or error-rate > 0.5%. Want to test per-tenant thresholds and circuit-breaker cooldowns.

jamal: SGTM. Are we measuring p95 at model-inference time or end-to-end (proxy + inference)?

maya: end-to-end for routing decisions, but we’ll publish both. routing policy uses inference p95 if available, else proxy p95.

sean: Important: implement hysteresis on CB, otherwise flapping during transient spikes. Ramping suggestions: 3 breaches in 60s -> open, cool-down 120s -> half-open.

lucy: For Console UX, we need a quick toggle: "Enable SLO-aware routing" + per-tier sliders for latency and availability. Also show recent breach events in the rollout timeline.\

anil: How does this interact with tenant quotas? If Gold gets preferential region routing but bursts a lot, we might starve Dedicated pool. Propose per-region capacity guard + soft quotas.

jamal: Agree. Add token-based capacity budget: each tier has region_budget and global_budget. Router checks region_budget before routing.

maya: Example policy draft (pseudo JSON):
```json
{
  "tier": "Gold",
  "preferred_regions": ["us-west-2","us-east-1"],
  "slo": {"p95_ms": 120, "availability_pct": 99.9},
  "fallback": {
    "on_latency_breach": {"action": "route_variant","variant": "quant-v2", "min_p95_ms": 180},
    "on_error_breach": {"action": "route_variant","variant": "fallback-small"}
  },
  "circuit_breaker": {"breach_count": 3, "window_s": 60, "cooldown_s": 120}
}
```

sean: That looks good. Suggest adding a field for "max_reroute_rate" to avoid overloading fallback variant: e.g., max_reroute_rate: 0.2 (20% of traffic).

lucy: UI should show "estimated cost delta" when fallback triggers — quant models are cheaper but may differ in quality. Product needs that for SLAs.

anil: Observability checklist: emit event on each decision with tags: tenant_id, tier, region, decision, metric_snapshot, cb_state. Also track regret metric: % of fallback decisions that later would have met SLO within 10s (false positives).

jamal: For automated rollouts, let's do canary by tenant: conditionally enable per-tenant with sampling 1%, 5%, 25%. We need a Console page to pick tenants by metadata.

maya: Deployment plan: 1) implement router changes + event schema, 2) wire Console toggles and visualizations, 3) run synthetic traffic against regional pools, 4) tenant canary with 10 tenants, 5) gradual ramp.

infra-bot: deploy/patchrouter v2 queued by maya — CI passed, infra review required. :rocket:

sean: One more: rollback policy — if overall platform p95 increases by >5% across all tiers during rollout, auto-disable SLO-routing feature flag and revert routing changes.

maya: noted. I'll add that to rollout playbook. Anyone want to own the metric dashboard? (Need per-tenant p95, cb_state timeseries, reroute counts, and regret).

lucy: I can own dashboard + Console hooks. Will prototype widgets: SLO breaches, CB timeline, Reroute heatmap.

anil: I'll handle quota/capacity guard logic and region_budget enforcement.

jamal: I'll implement router decision engine and max_reroute_rate.

maya: Thanks. Follow-up: I'll post a short RFC with the policy schema and rollout checklist. Expected RFC by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: scheduled run: integration-tests/region-routing v2 — started at 1769991300, ETA 10m.

sean: quick note: include a canary observer that simulates client latency distributions so we can tune hysteresis without impacting real tenants.

maya: Good call. Add synthetic observer to step 3.

jamal: One open question — for multi-model fallback (e.g., full->quant->small), do we allow multi-hop within one request chain or only a single fallback hop? If multi-hop, we need to bound attempts.

sean: limit to 1 fallback hop per request to keep tracing simple. If that fails, circuit-breaker trip.

maya: OK final decisions from thread: hysteresis + 3-in-60s, cooldown 120s, max_reroute_rate default 0.2, single fallback hop, per-region budgets enforced, Console + dashboard work owned. I'll draft RFC now.

lucy: :raised_hands:

anil: 👍

jamal: 👍

infra-bot: integration-tests/region-routing v2 — success at 1769991365

maya: Thanks all — RFC up in #eng-docs when ready.
